notes.title: One tab beats ten add-ins.
notes.body: Every tool on the BIM Tools tab follows the same pattern: select, choose, done. When tools share a home, a vocabulary and a settings dialog, the team learns the whole set in an afternoon instead of one plugin at a time.

notes.title: Flex the family before the project does.
notes.body: A family that only works at the sizes you tested is a bug waiting for a deadline. Build the guard formulas first, then push every parameter to its limit and watch what breaks. The flex test above is that habit, made visible.

notes.title: Clean files start clean.
notes.body: Most documentation pain is inherited from the template. A browser organisation that matches how the office thinks, view templates that are actually applied, and a standards check before issue remove most of it.

changelog: Planting Scatter gains Path Scatter and Edit Scatter. Shadow Links added to the Shadow Analysis panel.
Align Railing handles multi-segment railings. Sheet Manager renumbering keeps revision clouds attached.
Installer covers Revit 2023 to 2026 from one setup file. Seven legacy tools retired from the tab.
